caveats: The only labeller so far also wrote the dispositions being identified, so the human accuracy is an upper bound set by the roster's author rather than a reading by an arms-length critic. Replication by someone who did not write the dispositions is outstanding, and until then this is not evidence that a reader can tell these critics apart.

These score labels are not usable. 80% of them sit exactly on the real score's rounding grid with an inversion rate of 1.3%, which is the signature of the answer key rather than a reading of the prose. The sample this set was drawn from kept the answers in a plaintext file beside the sheet; later sets separate them.
